decisions.reason: As a flagship offshore vessel management service closely tied to our core capabilities and expansion into offshore and renewable energy markets, it remains strategically important despite limited recent website evidence.
Crew and corporate travel management is a practical adjacent service that strengthens our end-to-end maritime offering, so it is worth retaining unless demand is clearly disappointing.
The online vessel information portal supports customer proximity, transparency and scalable digital service delivery, which fits our strategic direction and argues for keeping it.

The mobile vessel performance app fits the push toward safer and more efficient operations, but as a narrower digital add-on it has the highest chance of being absorbed into another platform rather than being fully continued unchanged.
